description: Generate a two-path comparison that the browser renders side-by-side. Stores two named delegate PATHS (per-state candidate allocations) on the sim as Path A and Path B; when the user opens the sim in the simulator, the…

a.description: Path A: { label, shares }. shares maps state → { candidate_id: pct }.

apply_path.description: Explicit opt-in mutation: mirror Path A onto the live primary shares (+ stamp the primary mode and, if given, the roster) so the open map starts on Path A. Omit it to write only the compare artifact and preserve the current model version. A changed result creates a pre-apply checkpoint followed by one exact post-edit model version; an identical apply mints neither.

b.description: Path B, same shape as A.

candidates.description: Optional roster override [{id,name,color}] carried on the compare artifact (labels/colors for the compare renderer). The LIVE roster is only replaced under apply_path:"a". Omit to use the sim's field.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: set_compare_paths
